text: Considered numbering C-10's pair as axis 1 and axis 2, which an earlier draft did. Rejected after review: internal/calibrate already uses those labels for a different pair, where axis 1 is the human verdict and axis 2 the attributable cause. Numbering this pair the other way put two contradictory meanings of axis 1 in one codebase, in the rule whose purpose is stopping these fields being confused. Named the fields instead.
